paragraphs.text: Hatoki was Tetsuo Umezawa 's standard-bearer and the housekeeper of Umezawa Manor . He was an old man.
Hatoki was the leader of Clan Hatoki, of whom almost all members were servants of Tetsuo Umezawa . Hatoki followed the Imperial Champion on his trips to Sekana , Kusho and Argenti .
After the initial campaign, he stayed at Umezawa Manor tending to Kei Takahashi .
